chapter: Fourteen years with Nat Cole and the recording sessions
title: Teaching and Irving Ashby in the army
summary: Collins always taught guitarists and showed chords to Irving Ashby in the army at Fort Huachuca, who then joined Nat Cole.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Also, Pat, I know you're aware that I love to teach. And during that time I was doing some teaching also, as a matter of fact --

I think I always taught. You know, the guitar players just seem to gravitate towards me for some unknown reason, and I started right in teaching, you know. It's like turning a switch, and then I started in. But any way, speaking of teaching I did -- I was in the army with Irving Ashby, and we were in the same outfit, and I would sit up and play for him all day long and show him different chord structures, different melodies and things. And --
At this time we were in Fort Wachuga,

Arizona. So when we got out of the army he joined Nat, and I followed him with Nat, as you know. So I would -- you know, I liked to play between shows, like some of the guys would go out and do certain things. Well, I'd go to the dressing room and play. And I'm playing these things, and everybody's telling me, oh, Ashby taught you this. Said no, I taught Ashby. And he was telling them that he -- these were his things, you know.
So when I joined Nat he wouldn't come around, and I wondered why he wouldn't come around, but it was for this reason that he knew that they found out that these were my things. As a matter of fact --
